reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 9421, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The claimed purchase date of 2022-12-19 is before the recall sale window of 2023-10-01 to 2024-05-31. A purchase before the window is not eligible, even though the retailer is on the list.
No duplicate claims were found, so no flag applies. The serial check was skipped and did not affect the outcome.
